pages.caption: King Nebuchadnezzar raises a golden statue and commands everyone to bow before it.
Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego refuse to bow to anyone but God.
The king orders the furnace heated seven times hotter than usual.
In the flames a fourth figure walks with them, and they are unharmed.
They step out untouched, and the king praises the God who rescued them.
